skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: One-man Racing Team
skins.content: Whistlewind Series Race Driver Core Line/One-man Racing Team. He gets out of his work clothes and into his tricolor race outfit, riding his trusty hand-reared steed as they surge across the finish line in a blaze of glory. In this grand prix, all eyes are on him.
skins.quote: The organizer believed that, rather than allowing Chiave to tinker with other people's race cars, it would be better to approve his application as a solo participant. This meant Chiave ended up the grand prix's only driver who was also an engineer.
